subject: [PATCH] kernfs: avoid READ_ONCE() on a kgid_t in kernfs_new_node()

reviews.author: Danilo Krummrich
reviews.summary: Applied the patch to the driver-core-linus branch and mentioned that it will appear in the next linux-next integration.
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue, 27 Oct 2026 07:32:47 -0700, Shakeel Butt wrote:
> [PATCH] kernfs: avoid READ_ONCE() on a kgid_t in kernfs_new_node()

Applied, thanks!

  Branch: driver-core-linus
  Tree:   git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/driver-core/driver-core.git

[1/1] kernfs: avoid READ_ONCE() on a kgid_t in kernfs_new_node()
      commit: ef179363b043

The patch will appear in the next linux-next integration (typically within 24
hours on weekdays).

The patch is queued up for Linus's tree and should land in the next -rc release.

2026-11-02.patch_summary: The patch addresses a sparse warning on SMP alpha by reading the gid_t inside the kgid_t in kernfs_new_node() and wrapping it back up with KGIDT_INIT(). This change is safe as it does not alter the object code before or after GCC 12 for alpha and GCC 14 for x86-64.
